resources.rationale: Qualified book-cash proxy only. Neither exact unrestricted cash nor dated accessible deposits can be asserted.

obligations.rationale: Short-term loans/finance leases and separate operating leases preserved. Interest, guarantees and dated CAPEX remain qualified separately.

refinancing.rationale: Historical funding and interest coverage support capacity, not enforceable current financing. Dependence and adequacy are not jointly established.

restrictionReview.rationale: Restrictions and transferability remain unresolved; exclude unverified cash and deposits from certain liquidity.

covenantReview.rationale: Nondisclosure not equated with covenant clearance or evidence of a breach.

counter.rationale: Cash-only proxy is below 1x; financing history cannot establish coverage or severe dependence. Book deposits cannot be counted as available.

severeScenario.rationale: Reuse the public −25% scenario, stressed 10% margin, 5% working-capital drain, +3pp funding cost and 20% tax assumption.

earningsAndInterest.rationale: Operating EBIT and interest after the shock remain positive; weaker cover alone does not prove severe financial vulnerability.

cashAndCapex.rationale: Stressed cash proxy is below total CAPEX; maintenance floor unknown, no assumed deferral.

bufferAndMaturity.rationale: Book cash and deposit access sensitivities only. Known short-term principal and separate leases preserved.

fundingAndCapital.rationale: Plausible deposit sensitivity reverses funding deficit. No affirmative survival evidence or independently supported severe vulnerability.

counter.rationale: Negative stressed FCF and refinancing concentration signal exposure; deposit accessibility and CAPEX flexibility leave the band undetermined.
